title: More Adverbs: さぞ, さも, とっさに, とりわけ, まるっきり, それなりに / なりに, ままに
description: Surely must have, as if, on the spur of the moment, especially, (not) at all, in its own way, and as (one wishes / is told).

points.title: さぞ(かし): surely must have
points.summary: さぞ + だろう / ことでしょう = imagining someone else's feelings.
points.body: - 一人で大変だったでしょう。**さぞ**お疲れでしょう.
examples: さぞ{寒|さむ}かったことでしょう。
You must have been so cold.

points.title: さも: as if (really)
points.summary: さも + そうに / かのように = acting as though it were truly so.
points.body: - 彼は**さも**知っているかのように話した.
examples: さもおいしそうに{食|た}べる。
He eats as if it were really delicious.

points.title: とっさに: on the spur of the moment
points.summary: とっさに = instantly, without time to think.
points.body: - 車が来たので、**とっさに**身をかわした.
examples: とっさにうそをついてしまった。
I blurted out a lie on the spur of the moment.

points.title: とりわけ: especially
points.summary: とりわけ = above all, particularly.
points.body: - 今年の冬は**とりわけ**寒い.
examples: {果物|くだもの}の{中|なか}でも、とりわけいちごが{好|す}きだ。
Of all fruit, I particularly like strawberries.

points.title: まるっきり: (not) at all
points.summary: まるっきり + negative / だめ = completely (casual まったく).
points.body: - 彼の話は**まるっきり**意味がわからない.
examples: フランス{語|ご}はまるっきりだめだ。

points.title: それなり / 〜なりに: in its own way
points.summary: それなりの + noun = appropriate to it. N なりに = in N's own (limited) way.
points.body:
- 高い店には**それなり**の理由がある.
- 子供は子供**なりに**考えている.
examples: {子供|こども}は{子供|こども}なりに{考|かんが}えている。
Children think things through in their own way.

points.title: 〜ままに: as (one wishes / is told)
points.summary: Verb + ままに = just as A, following A.
points.body: - 気の向く**ままに**旅をした.
examples: {言|い}われるままに{契約書|けいやくしょ}にサインした。
I signed the contract just as I was told.

questions.prompt: {一人|ひとり}で{大変|たいへん}だったでしょう。（　）お{疲|つか}れでしょう。
questions.translation: That must have been hard on your own. You must be exhausted.

questions.prompt: What does 「さぞ{寒|さむ}かったことでしょう。」 mean?
options: You must have been so cold.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は（　）{知|し}っているかのように{話|はな}した。
questions.translation: He talked as though he knew all about it.

questions.prompt: What does 「さもおいしそうに{食|た}べる。」 mean?
options: He eats as if it were really delicious.
He doesn't seem to enjoy it.
He eats, and it's really delicious.

questions.prompt: {車|くるま}が{来|き}たので、（　）{身|み}をかわした。
questions.explanation: On the spur of the moment: **とっさに**.
questions.translation: A car came, so I instinctively jumped out of the way.

questions.prompt: What does 「とっさにうそをついてしまった。」 mean?
options: I blurted out a lie on the spur of the moment.
I was sure it was a lie.
I planned a lie long ago.

questions.prompt: {今年|ことし}の{冬|ふゆ}は（　）{寒|さむ}い。
notes: とっさに = 'on the spur of the moment'.

questions.prompt: What does 「{果物|くだもの}の{中|なか}でも、とりわけいちごが{好|す}きだ。」 mean?
options: Of all fruit, I particularly like strawberries.
I like strawberries in fruit salad.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は（　）{意味|いみ}がわからない。
notes: さぞ needs だろう and is for imagining someone else's feelings.
questions.translation: I can't make head or tail of what he says.

questions.prompt: What does 「フランス{語|ご}はまるっきりだめだ。」 mean?
{高|たか}い{店|みせ}には（　）の{理由|りゆう}がある。
notes: さも = 'as if' — さもの isn't grammatical.

questions.prompt: {子供|こども}は{子供|こども}（　）に{考|かんが}えている。
questions.translation: Children think things through in their own way.

questions.prompt: {休暇|きゅうか}は{気|き}の{向|む}く（　）{旅|たび}をした。
notes: とっさに = 'on the spur of the moment' — it can't follow 向く.
questions.translation: During the holidays I travelled wherever my fancy took me.

questions.prompt: What does 「{言|い}われるままに{契約書|けいやくしょ}にサインした。」 mean?
options: I signed the contract as it was.
I was told to sign it, but didn't.
I signed the contract just as I was told.
I signed it without being told.
